provenance: Layout from the documentation comment in dgen's decode.c (cited in references/genesis.md, not copied). 'published' is the example in that comment. 'public_list' codes come from Sonic 1 code lists agreed by several sources; they target the clean REV00 build, so the instruction at their address in the author's REV01 [h3C] dump does not match their description, as expected. 'rom_derived' patches were chosen from real instructions in that dump (SHA-1 1f1e480f768237eb0c0e725b622b0d791f47a7a9) and encoded by the throwaway port used to write this file; the independent letter check is docs/evals/genesis-letters.md.

rom_derived.note: replace SUBQ.B #1,($FE12).w (life lost, 4 bytes) with BRA.S +2 so its extension word is skipped; a 2-byte NOP would leave FE12 to be executed
start with 5 lives: immediate of MOVE.B #3,($FE12).w
